rationale: The pain is real but intermittent: model-tier selection is a periodic decision, not a daily blocker, and the HN thread shows intellectual curiosity more than operational suffering. No willingness-to-pay signal exists for a standalone benchmarking tool in this niche—developers expect free OSS scripts or built-in eval dashboards from their existing tooling. The market is too thin (indie devs spending $1–5/day on APIs) to sustain even a micro-SaaS at meaningful revenue.
